summary: AI Engineer with years building production LLM systems at JudgeService, a customer-insight platform for UK car dealerships. Shipped two AI products now live across major dealer groups, a review-reply service handling over 100k reviews a month with roughly 93% of drafts published unedited, and a multi-agent sentiment pipeline (0.98 F1) that powers client dashboards, feeds the company's complaint-handling platform and contributed to a 20% lift in client retention. Hands-on across MLOps, deployment, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Python, Docker, and GPU serving on AWS, Azure, and on-prem.
